deterministic_sample.rule: retain eventID when first byte of SHA256(UTF-8 eventID) is < 16

location_filter.reason: validation weather is ERA5 0.25-degree scale; records coarser than ~one ERA5 cell are excluded structurally

weather_grid.event_cell_rule: round latitude and longitude to nearest 0.25 degree before weather request

rainfall_metric.definition: number of consecutive days immediately before eventDate with precipitation <1 mm, capped at 30; 0 means previous local calendar day was wet

response.value: 1 if >=2 distinct scientificName records in eventID, else 0
response.conditioning: conditional on a submitted expert-validated frog recording

planned_adjustments: sin/cos local event hour if eventTime parseable on >=90% of sampled events

dependence.recorder_sensitivity: two-way or recorder-clustered sensitivity only if recordedBy coverage >=90%

support_rule: rain/dryness beta < 0, two-sided p < 0.05, and 95% CI excludes 0
